svg.aria-label: eCTD Compilation & Audit Platform: Drafts and audits the dossier a drug company files with regulators such as the FDA. A language model writes the words, but never a number: every value comes from a verified fact store, every claim is re-checked by code, and a person signs off before anything is filed. 3,589 numbers in the generated Word section, each traced to its source fact. 0 sentences the latest audit could not back with a fact. 643 automated tests, counted from the repository on every build. 59 build tasks shipped, each with its own evidence folder.

g.text: LEAD PROJECT · AI FOR DRUG REGULATION
Drafts and audits the dossier a drug company files with regulators such as the FDA. A language model
writes the words, but never a number: every value comes from a verified fact store, every claim is
re-checked by code, and a person signs off before anything is filed.
Only the two model steps are probabilistic, and code checks both before anything moves on. Every check ships with a planted-error test
could not back with a fact
Built with Python, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, a local Gemma model on Ollama, PyMuPDF, python-docx and Docker.
